`orders` is the constructor-injected `OrderService`. Its delegated operation is `OrderService.placeOrder` in `src/orders/order.service.ts` (lines 19–24), which creates and saves the `Order`. `OrdersModule` registers both `OrderService` and `OrderResolver` as NestJS providers (line 12).
